verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim a designer/PM can share a mockup and have the system implement it without handoff (factory-docs-8), plus Design mode to select an element and describe changes, diff review, and merge (factory-docs-19, factory-docs-1, factory-docs-18). However this is all first-party vendor documentation with no independent/hands-on corroboration that a non-engineer PM successfully completes this end-to-end, and the workflow still involves reviewing diffs/approvals which implies some technical judgment. Missing for 10: independent case studies or user reports of PMs (not engineers) completing mockup-to-merge without any engineering involvement, and detail on how ambiguous/complex mockups are handled.
